span.p:
Real risk of missed SLA
or active severity escalation

span.p:
Newer analyst brings you
a stuck triage call

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Have they stated their
own hypothesis and what
they've already ruled out?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ask them to state it first --
don't supply one yet

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Is their reasoning sound
but incomplete, or is a
real SLA/severity risk
about to be missed?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Name the one gap or next
step; let them execute it
and close the ticket

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Take the specific
high-risk action yourself,
narrating why out loud

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ticket closes with their
name on the disposition

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Debrief immediately after:
walk the reasoning you used,
return ownership for the writeup
